title: Robert Koch as the named discoverer node
dek: 1882 bacillus, tuberculin misadventure, postulates. History card. The organism plate owns the biology.
story: Robert Koch on Wikipedia is the discoverer node: 24 March 1882, acid-fast rods, later tuberculin as a failed therapeutic that became a skin-test ancestor.
World TB Day sits on that calendar. Calendar ≠ protocol.
Koch's postulates get their own neighbouring card because they are a method slogan still misapplied to LTBI and to NAATs.
deep: Nobel-era TB science also includes a lot of sanatorium air that is not DST.
Tuberculin the failed drug versus tuberculin the PPD ancestor is why Mantoux exists.
Do not cite Koch as a dosing authority.
H37Rv is a 20th-century laboratory descendant story, not Koch's original guinea pig.
